answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. The tundra is that the bill for trying is a deposit of 18 credits, frozen until 5 days after the grading closes, due at the door for every name. No Meridianbound map tracer harbour licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence map tracers carry after drawing room trials is why it holds. Every comet is counted once. The clerk notes basalt.
